en: Black-and-white photograph of a large Gothic or Neo‑Gothic building with steep slate roofs, ornate gables, traceried windows, and a tall, slender spire. A richly decorated external stair‑tower or loggia with pointed arches and balconies rises on the right side of the facade. The scene appears to be a quiet courtyard or square in front of a historic civic or castle‑like structure. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the front.
